text: mano anattā yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ . evaṃ passaṃ .pe. nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti . tatiyaṃ . #1 vimuttamhītipi pāṭho . [4] rūpā bhikkhave aniccā yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattā yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ . saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā dhammā aniccā yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattā yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ . evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpesupi nibbindati saddesupi nibbindati gandhesupi nibbindati rasesupi nibbindati phoṭṭhabbesupi nibbindati dhammesupi nibbindati nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati . vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti
